verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app, and user-defined event-triggered automation is a plausible axis for such a tool. However, the evidence documents no user-definable rules or triggers. The only related items are fixed, built-in behaviors: Launch at Login, automatic network handoff when you get home, and a daily update check. These are adjacent features, not a rules engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
